about: Vivec Arena debug minigame (dbgmode arenapit, docs/COMBAT.md): NPC records baked with combat frames (idle, run, attack, hit, knockdown, death) by tools/prepare_combat.py. The first row is the default opponent. Any other humanoid NPC record can still be chosen in game (gallery model or a stand-in, stats from combat/actors.txt). Add a row to add a fighter; each costs about 0.2 MB on disk.

fighters.note: Arena drillmaster, level 9, steel mace and chitin shield
Arena scout, level 9, steel longsword, boiled netch cuirass and helm
Arena Waistworks warrior, level 8 (autocalculated), steel longsword
Arena master-at-arms, level 25, ebony longsword and shield (strong)

playground_about: The combat playground's default casts (dbgmode combat aggro / group without names; docs/COMBAT.md "Combat playground"), written to arena/casts.txt. At most four NPC records each; stats from combat/actors.txt, stand-in models. The aggro cast spans the Fight ratings: one attacks on sight from across the Pit, one from mid-Pit, one only up close, and a Flee-100 pacifist who never attacks and runs once hit.
